sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.pkg_units, s.unit_basis, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route, p.strength, p.unit_content, p.pkg_unit FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE (lower(trim(coalesce(p.generic_name, ''))) RLIKE '^(?:[0-9.,]+ ?%?[^a-z0-9-]+)?(?:(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free)[^a-z0-9-]+)*isoleucine(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*(?:$|[^a-z0-9-].*)' OR (p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(trim(coalesce(s.description, ''))) RLIKE '^(?:[0-9.,]+ ?%?[^a-z0-9-]+)?(?:(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free)[^a-z0-9-]+)*isoleucine(?:-[a-z]{4})?(?:[^a-z0-9-]+(?:sodium|disodium|potassium|dipotassium|calcium|magnesium|hydrochloride|dihydrochloride|hcl|hydrobromide|sulfate|sulphate|phosphate|acetate|citrate|chloride|bromide|besylate|mesylate|maleate|tartrate|bitartrate|succinate|fumarate|gluconate|lactate|tromethamine|bicarbonate|carbonate|nitrate|hyclate|propionate|dipropionate|valerate|acetonide|pamoate|decanoate|meglumine|lysine|anhydrous|monohydrate|dihydrate|trihydrate|hexahydrate|base|free))*(?:$|[^a-z0-9-].*)')) ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key
